capabilities: Render Excel workbooks with fills, borders, merged cells, frozen panes and filters
Lay out Word documents as pages with styles, tables, images and headers
Present slide decks with a thumbnail rail, slideshow mode and speaker notes
Open CSV, TSV, ODS, ODT and RTF files in the same viewers
Search, zoom and inspect file details inside the view
disambiguation: Strictly read-only: it parses and draws files but has no save path, so editing still happens in the application that made the file.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Legacy .xls and .ppt are not supported and .doc renders as plain text; charts and some SmartArt show placeholders.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Office or OpenDocument attachments natively, so users must leave the app or hand files to a system viewer that loses context.
summary: Read-only viewer that renders Excel, Word, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, RTF and delimited files inside Obsidian with their saved styling.
